config.external_score: Native ResultEntry.Confidence; thresholds selected using calibration unknowns only

protocol.primary_task: Synthetic centered 5s content-ID adaptation, not standard ASR or fingerprint evaluation
protocol.common_query_headroom: If necessary scale every variant to source crop peak0.35 before perturbation
protocol.clipping_definition: Symmetric clipping at40%of headroom-scaled crop peak
protocol.eq_definition: FFT amplitude tilt linearly from-6dBat DC to+6dBat Nyquist,or reverse
protocol.packet_loss_definition: Exactly25of250nonoverlapping20mspackets zeroed at deterministic uniform positions;no time compression
protocol.mp3_definition: FFmpeg libmp3lame32kbps,16kHz mono,gapless file encode/decode,exact80000samples verified
protocol.threshold_selection: Calibration unknown scores only; target empiricalFPR<=0.01,report test counts/uncertainty

latency_note: Native normalization/fingerprint/hash extraction plus matching; FFmpeg decode separately recorded

precision_provenance.operation: Round native ResultEntry.Confidence to 12 decimal places for calibration and acceptance; preserve raw_score
precision_provenance.reason: Mathematically identical one-fingerprint coverage can differ by about 1e-14 from floating-point subtraction; tied evidence must not be split by numerical jitter
